title: Ultra-fine grain TixVNbMoTa refractory high-entropy alloys with superior mechanical properties fabricated by powder metallurgy
process_description: prepared by mechanical alloying (MA) with a ball-to-powder weight ratio of 10:1 at 350 rpm for 40 h under argon atmosphere, followed by spark plasma sintering (SPS) at 1600 °C for 10 min with an axial pressure of 50 MPa under vacuum (<1.3 × 10⁻² Pa).
